note: complementary log-log link on grouped binomial counts. The seeded points are drawn from the box (-1, 1) (point_halfwidth), not the default (-1.2, 1.2): there brms's log density is -inf at a seeded point (a k < size row at eta = 3.95, where Stan's 1 - inv_cloglog(eta) is exactly 0), and at (-1.1, 1.1) brms's log likelihood is 3.7e-6 relative off the exact value; (-1, 1) is the largest box on a 0.1 grid where it is finite and within LOGP_REL of the exact value (8.6e-11), and log densities never fall back on a reference (P6)
